title: Magical AI Music Video - "Happier Without You" - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
I wrote a breakup song last night for a friend of mine. Well, I wrote the lyrics and used #Suno to work out the music. I love how it came out. Animated these cool images using @Luma AI #DreamMachine #Ray2 image to video. Images made with #Midjourney. Here’s the lyrics in case anyone needs a little positivity after a breakup:

I tried to find me in the silence
But your voice was in my head
I traced the past like broken diamonds
Looking for the words you said

And I
Tried to forgive you
Then I
Learned to forgive myself

Saw the light without your shadow
Felt the weight begin to fade
I was lost inside your echoes
Now I’m breathing my own way
I thought I’d be nothing without you
But I’m finally standing tall
Didn’t know how much I needed
To lose you after all

I held on tight to all the memories
Thought they’d keep me safe and whole
But love should never feel like drowning
I had to learn to let you go

And I
Used to believe you
But now
I believe in me

Saw the light without your shadow
Felt the weight begin to fade
I was lost inside your echoes
Now I’m breathing my own way
I thought I’d be nothing without you
But I’m finally standing tall
Didn’t know how much I needed
To lose you after all

No more waiting on a love that left me cold
No more looking back at stories left untold
You were once my home, now I see it clear
I don’t need you here

Saw the light without your shadow
Felt the weight begin to fade
I was lost inside your echoes
Now I’m breathing my own way
I thought I’d be nothing without you
But I’m finally standing tall
Didn’t know how much I needed
To lose you after all

I tried to find me…
And now I see…
I’m happier without you

#ai #aiart #aiimages #aivideo #aimusic #breakupsong #Suno

top_comments.author: @off-white-eggs
top_comments.text: Kelly, your work is breathtaking. Watching your characters, especially in the 'Future Dance' series, reminds me so much of a legendary avant-garde singer from the 80s/90s, Zhanna Aguzarova. She was our 'Martian' long before AI. There's a scene in my mind: a star illuminating her proud profile and wrinkled forehead as she steps into the water in her iconic platform boots. It's a dialogue between past and future, age and eternity. Your art captures that exact 'cosmic' soul. Thank you for this meditation.
